item.title: [LU-20515] LBUG in lnet_destroy_peer_locked() During Peer Discovery After MR Reconfiguration
item.description:
Repeatedly deleting and re-adding one NI of a two-rail LNet network on a Lustre server
panics the kernel. Reproduced 4 times on master (`2.17.54_183_gc088134`), always the
same assertion and call stack, in the `lnet_discovery` kernel thread.

[ 1680.840533] LNetError: 18633:0:(peer.c:278:lnet_destroy_peer_locked()) ASSERTION( list_empty(&lp->lp_peer_nets) ) failed: 
[ 1680.844355] LNetError: 18633:0:(peer.c:278:lnet_destroy_peer_locked()) LBUG
[ 1680.846782] CPU: 1 PID: 18633 Comm: lnet_discovery Kdump: loaded Tainted: G           OE     -------- -  - 4.18.0-553.123.1.el8_lustre.ddn17.x86_64 #1
[ 1680.851151] Hardware name: DDN SFA400X3ME, BIOS 1.17.0-20260414_171146-ponderosa 04/01/2014
[ 1680.853954] Call Trace:
[ 1680.854946]  dump_stack+0x41/0x60
[ 1680.856202]  lbug_with_loc.cold.7+0x5/0x43 [libcfs]
[ 1680.857949]  lnet_destroy_peer_locked+0x293/0x300 [lnet]
[ 1680.859879]  lnet_peer_attach_peer_ni+0x544/0x600 [lnet]
[ 1680.861804]  ? lnet_peer_add_nid+0x131/0x510 [lnet]
[ 1680.863597]  lnet_peer_merge_data+0x756/0x1250 [lnet]
[ 1680.865414]  lnet_peer_discovery+0x155f/0x1b50 [lnet]
[ 1680.867230]  ? lnet_peer_merge_data+0x1250/0x1250 [lnet]
[ 1680.869121]  kthread+0x134/0x150
[ 1680.870349]  ? set_kthread_struct+0x50/0x50
[ 1680.871875]  ret_from_fork+0x1f/0x40
[ 1680.873250] Kernel panic - not syncing: LBUG

Environment

  • Lustre master, commit `c088134a8e` (`2.17.54_183_gc088134`), server build, EL8
  • Kernel `4.18.0-553.123.1.el8_lustre.ddn17.x86_64`, Rocky Linux 8.10
  • Server has 4 multi-rail LNet networks configured simultaneously (`tcp10`, `tcp11`, `o2ib12`, `o2ib13`), each with 2 NIs on VLAN sub-interfaces (`mlxen0.N` + `mlxen1.N`, same `/24` subnet per net) — only `o2ib12` was churned to trigger the crash
  • `o2ib12`: 2 NIs on the server, `mlxen0.12` + `mlxen1.12`
  • At least one client mounted over `o2ib12` with ordinary I/O in progress

Steps to Reproduce

lnetctl net del --net o2ib12
lnetctl net add --net o2ib12 --if mlxen0.12      # Reduce to a single NI
sleep 3
lnetctl net add --net o2ib12 --if mlxen1.12      # Restore two NIs
sleep 3

On the clients:
Verify that all peers are discovered correctly.

Repeat the above sequence multiple times.

The server occasionally hits an LBUG in lnet_destroy_peer_locked() during peer discovery. The issue occurs intermittently after repeating the above sequence several times.
